entries.title: Wayne County NY Real Property Tax Service
entries.summary: Official Wayne County entry point for assessment rolls, tax maps, historical property data, assessor contacts, and the parcel viewer.
entries.limitations: Tax maps and parcel attribution are evidence inputs, not legal surveys or title opinions.

entries.title: Wayne County NY GIS Department
entries.summary: Official county GIS program and public geospatial-service entry point for Wayne County parcels and mapped layers.
entries.limitations: Public layers may change and parcel lines are not a substitute for a survey.

entries.title: New York Statewide Parcel Map Program
entries.summary: Official statewide discovery and standardized annual GIS parcel-data program, with county-specific resource links.
entries.limitations: The statewide standardized parcel dataset is generally annual; use county sources for the freshest local attribution.

entries.title: NYSDEC Environmental Resource Mapper
entries.summary: Official New York environmental screening map for wetlands, waters, biodiversity, and related conservation layers.
entries.limitations: Informational mapping cannot establish the presence or absence of jurisdictional wetlands; an official jurisdictional determination may be required.

entries.title: FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer
entries.summary: Official federal flood-hazard mapping source for effective panels, zones, and supporting layer metadata.
entries.limitations: Record effective map date and panel; map review does not replace a surveyor, insurer, or floodplain administrator determination.

entries.title: USDA NRCS Web Soil Survey
entries.summary: Official national soil survey interface for mapped soil units, interpretations, and survey reports.
entries.limitations: Soil mapping supports planning; onsite investigation may be needed for engineering, septic, or legal conclusions.

entries.title: OpenStreetMap and governed routing
entries.summary: Community map and routing context used only for geographic orientation and route hypotheses, not legal-access conclusions.
entries.limitations: Routing and road proximity are contextual and do not prove legal access, frontage, easements, or road maintenance status.
